meta.parties: Edirisinghe v. District Judge of Matara

rules.statement: The District Court has inherent jurisdiction to hold an inquiry when the execution of its order is obstructed, as implied by the Partition Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Such a power is implied in the Partition Ordinance under which he issued the Commission for the sale of the land in question, for it is rule of statute law that when the legislature confers a jurisdiction it impliedly grants the power of doing all such acts as are essential to the exercise of the jurisdiction so conferred."
